It was an absolute disappointment after the second visit. 
My first visit was 2 weeks ago, on a busy Monday afternoon. Although it took 30 mins for both of my tasting flight and the duck dish, they both tasted delicious. Beer was cold, at the right temperature and top notch. Duck dish was very tasty (I was very surprised); even tasted better than some authentic places in District 5 where you can find a lot of well-known places for this type of dish. I and my friends kept ordering grilled seafood, edamame snack (with garlicky-soy infused, also tasty); few more big flights and we ended up tipsy but happy after all.
Second visit, last week, was an absolute disaster and brought to my conclusion that it was no better than other places. My friends visited me from the US, and of course, it was a debate whether I should take them here cause they have tons of good breweries in the States. After a lot of back and forth and based on my last experience, I successfully convinced them to come to the biggest brewery in the city. Well, can't be more wrong. It was a very crowded Friday night. I ordered almost the same dishes and drinks for my friends (better be safe than sorry, right?). And after 45 mins waiting, we were informed most of the beer was out of stock, more than half, jeez, and this is a brewery for God's sake. We ended up drinking cocktails instead (and God forbid, not good). Little did I know, the food were awful. Duck was bland, absolutely had no flavor not like last visit, and the baos come with them, surprisingly, 2 were saggy and 2 were cold (how?); the most horrible part was I gave them a good credit on this dish and was bragging about it with my friends a lot. Another 30 mins wait on the grilled seafood, and by the time it came to our table, COLD COLD COLD, as cold as the beer and it looked messy on the board. 30 more mins for garlicky edamame soaked in oil; fried rice was dry, super dry; medium rib eye was overcooked and the freaking sauce came with it tasted like cake batter. We had few more different dishes, I couldn't remember the name, but they were all floppy, cold, and dull. The only good thing was the tuna avocado salad, the ginger dressing was good, and that was it.
What a night! Bad experience and I felt very embarrassed with my friends. And another mind-blown fact was: as we was walking down the street, we saw another bar carrying this brewery's beers with half a price, AND they had everything we wanted to taste in stock.
